title: Cartwise+ Membership Goodwill on Grocery Order Photo-Review Claims
content:
# Cartwise+ Membership goodwill on photo-review claims

**Member benefit.** On a Cartwise Grocery Orders photo-review claim, a goodwill raise is set by the Cartwise+ plan recorded on the order and the period fees in the customer's membership ledger. When that plan is annual and the customer's membership ledger shows at least 1 period fee charged within the last 12 whole calendar months, the raise is 10 percent; when it is monthly and the ledger shows at least 6 period fees within the last 6 whole calendar months, the raise is 5 percent; otherwise there is none. The raise applies to the claim figure made of the line value and any service-fee part added to it, and the raised figure is rounded to the cent.

Months are counted by anniversary: between an earlier date and a later date as many whole months have passed as there are monthly anniversaries of the earlier date falling on or before the later date, so a period fee counts as charged within the last N whole calendar months when fewer than N such months have passed from its charge date to today, and a fee charged earlier in the current month is 0 months old.

| Plan on the recorded Cartwise+ Membership | Ledger condition | Goodwill raise |
|---|---|---|
| Annual | At least 1 period fee within the last 12 whole calendar months | 10 percent |
| Monthly | At least 6 period fees within the last 6 whole calendar months | 5 percent |
| Other positions, or no plan recorded on the order | — | None |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- An annual member whose only period fee was charged 11 whole months ago: the fee counts, the raise is 10 percent. A claim figure of 13.98 becomes 15.378, rounded to 15.38.
- An annual member whose only period fee was charged 12 whole months ago: the fee no longer counts; no raise.
- A monthly member with 6 period fees in the last 6 whole calendar months: 5 percent. A claim figure of 13.98 becomes 14.679, rounded to 14.68.
- A monthly member with 5 period fees in that window: no raise.
- A period fee charged on the 2nd of the current month, read on the 20th: 0 months old, and it counts in either window.
